national_news.title: PM Modi Launches ₹15,600 Crore Infrastructure Projects in Bengaluru; Highlights 300 GW Renewable Target
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched development projects worth over ₹15,600 crore in Bengaluru, spanning metro, railway modernization, and energy infrastructure.
Highlighted that India's total renewable energy capacity has crossed the 300 Gigawatt (GW) mark, driven by central initiatives like PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana and PM-KUSUM.
Unveiled key energy facilities in Karnataka including an 80,000 MT Mangaluru LPG storage facility, Devangonthi Marketing Terminal, and a 13 tonnes-per-day Compressed Biogas plant in Bengaluru.

national_news.title: Union Environment Minister Reviews Delhi-NCR Air Pollution; Directs Sealing of 191 Polluting Units
bullets: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav chaired a joint review meeting with NCR states (Delhi, Haryana, UP, Rajasthan) to enforce air pollution control measures.
Directed the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to immediately seal 191 non-conforming polluting industries that failed to install mandatory Air Pollution Control Devices (APCDs).

Ordered the nomination of Secretary-level officers for 15 NCR cities across Haryana, UP, and Rajasthan to monitor field-level compliance and report weekly to the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

national_news.title: India Records All-Time High Exports of Nearly $90 Billion in October
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal announced that India achieved a record monthly export figure of nearly $90 billion in October 2024, comprising $50 billion in merchandise exports and $40 billion in services exports.
Cumulative exports for the first seven months (April-October) of FY 2024-25 reached $570 billion, aligning with the target of achieving $1 trillion in annual exports.
The 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF), organized by the India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO) in New Delhi, launched with the theme 'Vikas aur Virasat' featuring over 3,500 exhibitors.

national_news.title: CCPA Imposes ₹10 Lakh Penalty on Ride-Hailing Platform for Pre-Ride Tipping Prompt
bullets: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), headed by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, penalized a cab platform ₹10 lakh for employing dark patterns via pre-ride tipping prompts.
The pre-ride tipping practice was declared an unfair trade practice, violating Clause 14.15 of the Motor Vehicles Aggregators Guidelines, 2025.
Guidelines mandate that tipping prompts can strictly be offered to consumers only after the completion of a journey.

national_news.title: WHO Global TB Report Highlights 38% Reduction in India's TB Mortality Since 2015
bullets: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda highlighted findings from the WHO Global TB Report 2026, recording a 38% decline in India's TB mortality since 2015, outperforming the global average of 35%.
India achieved a 94% treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB, covering over 25 crore people under intensified screening in the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
Key initiatives driving success include AI-enabled diagnostics, financial/nutritional support through Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana, and community engagement via Ni-kshay Mitras.

national_news.title: 3rd ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report Released in New Delhi
bullets: Secretary (East) in MEA, Rudendra Tandon, released the 3rd edition of the ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report (AIDCR) 2026 titled 'Navigating Global Uncertainties and Strengthening Partnerships'.
The report release precedes Prime Minister Narendra Modi's upcoming visit to Manila for the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit.
Focus areas of engagement under India's Act East Policy include trade integration, maritime security, and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR).

national_news.title: Lalremsiami Hmar Becomes First Sportsperson from Mizoram to Receive Arjuna Award
bullets: Indian women's hockey player Lalremsiami Hmar became the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award, presented by President Droupadi Murmu.
She was selected among 17 sportspersons for the Arjuna Award 2025 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
Lalremsiami was also the first Mizo sportsperson to win an Asian Games medal (2018 silver) and the first woman from the state to compete at the Olympic Games (Tokyo 2020).

national_news.title: NSEIX Expands Indian Investors' Access to European Markets via GIFT City Platform
bullets: NSE International Exchange (NSEIX) expanded its global investment platform into seven European markets via its entity NSEIX Global Access IFSC Limited in GIFT City.

The expanded framework provides Indian investors access to over 11,500 securities and 8,200 Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) ETFs across European nations including France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Switzerland, and the UK.
NSEIXGA operates under the regulatory framework of the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) to facilitate cross-border diversification.

national_news.title: National Tribal Pride March Begins to Mark 151st Birth Anniversary of Birsa Munda
bullets: The three-day National Tribal Pride March was flagged off from Ulihatu in Khunti district, Jharkhand, the birthplace of Bhagwan Birsa Munda, to mark his 151st birth anniversary and Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas.
The march carries the legacy of Birsa Munda's 'Ulgulan' (rebellion) and will conclude at his memorial in Kokar, Ranchi, on November 15.
The observance commemorates the contributions and supreme sacrifice of 'Dharti Aaba' Bhagwan Birsa Munda in India's freedom struggle.

national_news.title: CBDT Implements Special Campaign 6.0 for Swachhata and Administrative Efficiency
bullets: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) implemented Special Campaign 6.0 across all field formations of the Income Tax Department following guidelines from the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).
The campaign freed up 1.54 lakh sq ft of office space, generated Rs 36.9 lakh in revenue from scrap sales, weeded out over 90,000 physical files, and disposed of 29,153 public grievances.
Key regional initiatives included the installation of a zero-cost 'Waste to Art' structure named 'Gaj-Garuda' made from scrap materials at the Income Tax Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

national_news.title: Government Merges Central Bureau of Communication with Press Information Bureau
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) merged the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) with the Press Information Bureau (PIB) at the headquarters level into a single unified entity named PIB.
The unified organization will be headed by the Director-General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi, who will report directly to the Chairman of the Communication Board.
CBC was originally created on December 8, 2017, by integrating the Directorate of Advertising and Visual Publicity (DAVP), Directorate of Field Publicity (DFP), and Song and Drama Division (S&DD).

national_news.title: MIB Restructures PIB and CBC Under Unified Organisational Framework
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an office memorandum establishing a functional integration of CBC into PIB, placing all Additional Director General (ADG)-level officers under DG (Coordination), PIB.
Communication and Media Coordinators (CMCs) posted across central ministries and state-level offices will report to the DG (Coordination) to streamline 360-degree media planning.
The restructured entity is organized into functional verticals covering media advertising, outreach exhibitions, New India Samachar, print booklets, fact-checking, and social media facilitation.

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates India's First LED Dome Planetarium 'COSMOS-Mysuru'
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated 'COSMOS-Mysuru', India's first LED Dome Planetarium, in Mysuru, Karnataka.

The address showcased key ISRO milestones including Chandrayaan-3, Aditya-L1 solar observatory, and the Space Docking Experiment (SpaDeX), which made India the fourth nation to demonstrate space docking.
Practical satellite technology applications were highlighted, including ISRO's real-time train tracking collaboration with Indian Railways and cyclone warning systems for maritime safety.

national_news.title: MIB Merges PIB and CBC into Single Administrative Structure
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) functionally merged the Press Information Bureau (PIB) and the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into a single entity operating under the PIB name.
The merged headquarters in New Delhi will be led by a newly created Director General (Coordination), PIB, reporting to the Chairperson of the Communication Board.
R K Jain, former Director General (News) at All India Radio's News Services Division, has been appointed as DG (Coordination), PIB.

national_news.title: Government Integrates PIB and CBC Media and Advertising Operations
bullets: The functional integration brings central government media relations, advertising, publicity, research, and fact-checking under a unified administrative framework.
Additional Director General (ADG)-level officers and Communication and Media Coordinators (CMCs) across central ministries will report to the DG (Coordination), PIB.
The initiative builds upon the 2022 regional office integration and will be extended to state and branch offices in phases.

national_news.title: MIB Restructures PIB and CBC Headquarters in New Delhi
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting ordered the administrative consolidation of PIB and CBC headquarters into one entity named Press Information Bureau.
The new structure unifies print advertising, audio-visual publicity, social media outreach, exhibitions, and media coordination under one leadership.
Former AIR News Services Division DG R K Jain was appointed to lead the integrated PIB setup as DG (Coordination).

national_news.title: Cabinet Approves ₹3,230 Crore Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at North and South Block
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum in New Delhi at an estimated cost of ₹3,230 crore.
The national project involves adaptive reuse of the historic North and South Block complex while preserving their original architectural character and heritage significance.
Appraised by the Public Investment Board (PIB), the implementation of the civilisational museum will take place in phases between FY 2026–27 and FY 2030–31.

national_news.title: India Records 38% Drop in TB Mortality Rate According to WHO Report
bullets: According to the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026, India achieved a 38% reduction in TB mortality since 2015, outperforming the global decline of 35%.
India registered a 94% treatment success rate among drug-susceptible TB patients with over 25 crore people screened under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
Key initiatives driving progress include AI-enabled diagnostics, financial support under Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana, and community engagement via Ni-kshay Mitras.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish 44 Hi-Tech Sugarcane Nurseries Under PPP Model
bullets: The Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department has launched a scheme to establish 44 hi-tech sugarcane nurseries across the state under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The initiative aims to produce 2.20 crore disease-free sugarcane seedlings annually using single-bud plantlet technology to support sugarcane expansion and new sugar mills.
The government will provide a 75% subsidy on the project cost, capping at Rs 11.25 lakh per nursery out of an estimated setup cost of Rs 15 lakh per unit.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th in World's Top 100 Museums List
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum ranked 9th on German travel guide 'Worth a Journey's' list of the world's 100 best museums for 2026, making it the highest-placed museum in Asia and the only Indian entry.
The 13.9-acre complex was designed by Japanese firm Maki and Associates along with Mumbai-based OPOLIS, and officially opened its initial galleries in August 2015.
Key exhibits include the iconic 3rd-century BCE Didarganj Yakshi, a 5-foot-2-inch Chunar sandstone sculpture discovered near the Ganga River in Patna in 1917.

bihar_news.title: Tigers from Bihar and Assam to be Relocated to Buxa Tiger Reserve
bullets: West Bengal announced plans to translocate two tigers from Bihar and Assam to the Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) in Alipurduar district under the supervision of the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA).
In October 2026, a three-year-old tigress (T138) from Bihar's Valmiki Tiger Reserve was translocated to BTR as part of the phased tiger reintroduction programme.

The Buxa Tiger Recovery Initiative has been implemented jointly by West Bengal, the NTCA, and the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) since 2018, involving prey-base augmentation and habitat restoration.

bihar_news.title: Six-Lane Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Bridge 'Nitish Setu' Set for Inauguration in Bihar
bullets: The six-lane Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur bridge across the River Ganga, named 'Nitish Setu', links the Patna side with Bidupur in Vaishali district.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to dedicate the bridge and inaugurate the Jandaha-Rajapakar industrial area in Vaishali district.
The state government deployed 35 senior officials to coordinate administrative preparations across departments ahead of the project launch.
